function controlSelectorsCase(variant) {
 const checks={},host=document.createElement('section');host.className='control-scope';document.body.append(host);const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='.control-scope{background-color:rgb(1,2,3)}.control-scope:has(:checked){background-color:rgb(4,5,6)}.control-scope input{background-color:rgb(10,20,30)}.control-scope input:checked{background-color:rgb(40,50,60)}.control-scope input:indeterminate{color:rgb(70,80,90)}.control-scope input:disabled{background-color:rgb(100,110,120)}';document.head.append(style);
 const make=(type='checkbox')=>{const x=document.createElement('input');x.type=type;host.append(x);return x};const box=make(),text=make('text');
 checks.clean=!box.matches(':checked')&&box.matches(':enabled')&&!box.matches(':disabled');checks.initialCss=getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor==='rgb(10, 20, 30)';checks.initialParent=getComputedStyle(host).backgroundColor==='rgb(1, 2, 3)';
 box.checked=true;checks.currentChecked=box.matches(':checked');checks.dirtyAttribute=!box.hasAttribute('checked');checks.currentCss=getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor==='rgb(40, 50, 60)';checks.parentCss=getComputedStyle(host).backgroundColor==='rgb(4, 5, 6)';checks.queryCurrent=host.querySelector(':checked')===box;checks.closestCurrent=box.closest(':checked')===box;
 box.checked=false;box.defaultChecked=true;checks.dirtyFalse=!box.matches(':checked')&&box.hasAttribute('checked');checks.resetCss=getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor==='rgb(10, 20, 30)';checks.resetParent=getComputedStyle(host).backgroundColor==='rgb(1, 2, 3)';
 box.indeterminate=true;checks.checkboxIndeterminate=box.matches(':indeterminate');checks.indeterminateCss=getComputedStyle(box).color==='rgb(70, 80, 90)';box.checked=true;checks.indeterminateOverrides=box.checked&&box.matches(':indeterminate')&&!box.matches(':checked');box.indeterminate=false;checks.indeterminateReset=!box.matches(':indeterminate');
 text.checked=true;text.indeterminate=true;checks.textExcluded=!text.matches(':checked')&&!text.matches(':indeterminate');
 box.disabled=true;checks.disabledCurrent=box.matches(':disabled')&&!box.matches(':enabled');checks.disabledCss=getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor==='rgb(100, 110, 120)';box.disabled=false;checks.enabledReset=box.matches(':enabled')&&getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor==='rgb(40, 50, 60)';
 checks.compound=host.querySelector('input:is(:checked,:disabled):not(:indeterminate)')===box;checks.relational=host.matches(':has(> input:checked)');checks.nthState=host.querySelector('input:nth-child(1 of :checked)')===box;
 const a=make('radio'),b=make('radio');a.name=b.name='query-'+variant;checks.emptyRadio=a.matches(':indeterminate')&&b.matches(':indeterminate');a.checked=true;checks.selectedRadio=a.matches(':checked')&&!a.matches(':indeterminate')&&!b.matches(':indeterminate');b.checked=true;checks.radioTransfer=!a.matches(':checked')&&b.matches(':checked')&&!a.matches(':indeterminate');b.name='away-'+variant;checks.radioName=a.matches(':indeterminate')&&!b.matches(':indeterminate');
 const unnamed=make('radio');checks.unnamedEmpty=unnamed.matches(':indeterminate');unnamed.checked=true;checks.unnamedSelected=unnamed.matches(':checked')&&!unnamed.matches(':indeterminate');
 const fieldset=document.createElement('fieldset'),legend=document.createElement('legend'),other=document.createElement('legend');fieldset.append(legend,other);host.append(fieldset);fieldset.setAttribute('disabled','');const exempt=document.createElement('input'),blocked=document.createElement('input'),second=document.createElement('input');legend.append(exempt);other.append(second);fieldset.append(blocked);checks.fieldset=fieldset.matches(':disabled')&&blocked.matches(':disabled')&&second.matches(':disabled');checks.legend=exempt.matches(':enabled')&&!exempt.matches(':disabled');fieldset.removeAttribute('disabled');checks.fieldsetReset=fieldset.matches(':enabled')&&blocked.matches(':enabled');
 const outer=document.createElement('fieldset'),inner=document.createElement('fieldset'),group=document.createElement('optgroup'),option=document.createElement('option');outer.setAttribute('disabled','');outer.append(inner,group);group.append(option);host.append(outer);checks.nestedFieldset=inner.matches(':disabled');checks.optionFieldset=group.matches(':enabled')&&option.matches(':enabled');group.setAttribute('disabled','');checks.optionGroup=group.matches(':disabled')&&option.matches(':disabled');
 const div=document.createElement('div');div.setAttribute('disabled','');host.append(div);checks.nonControls=!div.matches(':enabled')&&!div.matches(':disabled');const foreign=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','input');foreign.setAttribute('type','checkbox');foreign.setAttribute('checked','');foreign.setAttribute('disabled','');host.append(foreign);checks.namespace=!foreign.matches(':checked')&&!foreign.matches(':disabled')&&!foreign.matches(':enabled');
 const progress=document.createElement('progress');host.append(progress);checks.progressEmpty=progress.matches(':indeterminate');progress.setAttribute('value','0');checks.progressValue=!progress.matches(':indeterminate');
 const hidden=make('hidden');hidden.checked=true;checks.hiddenState=hidden.matches(':enabled')&&!hidden.matches(':checked');
 const shadowHost=document.createElement('div');host.append(shadowHost);const root=shadowHost.attachShadow({mode:'open'}),inside=document.createElement('input');inside.type='checkbox';root.append(inside);inside.checked=true;checks.shadowQuery=root.querySelector(':checked')===inside;checks.shadowIsolation=!Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(':checked')).includes(inside);
 const attrBox=make();const attr=document.createAttribute('checked');attrBox.setAttributeNode(attr);checks.attrNode=attrBox.matches(':checked');attrBox.checked=false;attr.value='changed';checks.attrDirty=!attrBox.matches(':checked');
 host.remove();style.remove();return checks;
}
